messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — observability gap detected for tenant 'eclipse-fin' (VPC: vpc-us-west-2-dedicated-3). Missing traces and partial log fragments starting ~2026-03-15T10:42:00Z. Severity: P1. Affected surfaces: request traces, application logs (tailing), metrics shards for tenant. Page target: @amber_oncall.

amber_oncall: seeing it. taking pager. can folks drop what they're doing and help triage? any customer impact reports yet?

jen_sre: I'm on it. spikes in forwarder error rate for that pool, and the trace sampler for the tenant is reporting 0 spans forwarded. logs show repeated 403 when calling obs-forwarder: `403 Forbidden - token missing/invalid` for tenant-id ecl-772.

matt_infra: confirming infra telemetry — forwarder instances in dedicated-3 show sustained 5xx on the egress to obs-proxy. connection resets, then auth failures. Could be lease rotation + stale secret.

raj_runtime: adding context — the dedicated pool uses per-tenant ephemeral forwarder credentials rotated every 24h. If rotation fails while the lease is active, the forwarder will drop spans but still accept requests locally, so apps look fine but traces disappear.

tara_support: Customer (Eclipse Fin) opened a support channel asking why recent requests have no traces in Console. They've lost visibility for a handful of high-value transactions in the last 20m. They are PRIMED and waiting.

amber_oncall: ok immediate plan: 1) validate forwarder lease for tenant, 2) temporarily enable proxy-bypass for tenant to get traces out, 3) create an observable fallback and CRT log bundle for customer. Who can rotate/inspect secrets now?

matt_infra: I can check rotation status. pulling lease table for ecl-772...```
matt_infra: # aws dynamodb get-item --table ForwarderLeases --key '{"tenant":"ecl-772"}' --region us-west-2
```

matt_infra: lease state: ACTIVE, last_rotated: 2026-03-14T11:05:12Z, rotation_job: failed at 2026-03-15T08:41:02Z with 502 from secret-manager-proxy. getting logs from secret-manager now.

jen_sre: while matt digs secrets, I can enable a temporary sampler override at the ingress to force trace export for ecl-772 (low risk). That will at least capture spans until forwarder is healthy. Anyone object?

raj_runtime: do it. also enabling prefix caching for that tenant so repeated requests don't create more noise. sampler override command (run on ingress-master nodes):
```
# k8s exec -n ingress ingress-master-0 -- ./adminctl sampler set --tenant ecl-772 --rate 1.0 --ttl 20m
```

amber_oncall: jen/raj please run that and confirm. matt keep working secrets. tara please tell customer we have a mitigation in flight and we'll restore full tracing shortly. luis from custops can you be the face to Eclipse Fin?

luis_custops: on it — pinged customer, told them we're investigating and will enable temporary capture. asking for any impacted request IDs to prioritize. they gave 2 sample request IDs.

jen_sre: sampler override applied on ingress-master-0 and -1. now seeing local spans captured; however export still failing with 403 from obs-proxy when samplers call the forwarder endpoint.

matt_infra: secret-manager logs show the rotation job failed due to TLS handshake errors with the KMS endpoint — intermittent. I can re-run rotation for ecl-772 manually with a forced refresh if ops approves.

amber_oncall: approve manual rotation. matt, coordinate restart of forwarder for tenant after rotation. Raj, keep prefix caching and sampler on for 30m, then step down to normal rate once we see successful exports. Tara, post update to customer channel templated with timeline.

matt_infra: forced rotation kicked off. forcing forwarder restart for dedicated-3 forwarder group ecl-772:```
# infractl forwarder restart --pool dedicated-3 --tenant ecl-772 --reason "rotation retry"
```

matt_infra: restart completed on 3/3 forwarders. post-restart health checks: all forwarders reporting healthy, auth token present. attempting handshake to obs-proxy...

raj_runtime: I see successful handshakes and 200s on initial post. spans are flowing into staging observability pipeline. catching up on backlog — KM backlog drain rate looks normal.

jen_sre: Console traces for sample request IDs from customer are appearing now. tag the runbook: `runbooks/tenant-forwarder-rotation.md` and mark as mitigation step.

amber_oncall: great. customer impact: reduced trace visibility for ~20m window, partial log fragments missing for same window, metrics shard availability degraded but no metric loss yet. ETA to full restore: 10 minutes (monitoring).

tara_support: updated customer channel: "We've identified a forwarder credential rotation failure impacting trace export for your VPC. We've forced a rotation and restart; traces are returning. We'll monitor for 60 minutes and follow up with a post-incident summary." customer acknowledged.

luis_custops: customer asked for postmortem & whether this could recur. I'd recommend immediate short-term: extend next rotation window for this tenant to avoid back-to-back rotations until upstream KMS flakiness is resolved. Long-term: add retry circuit in rotation job and add a shadow rotation test.

matt_infra: filing infra task to add retry + alert on rotation failures. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4721

amber_oncall: outstanding actions: 1) infra to add rotation retry (matt) 2) runtime to keep sampler override for 30m (raj) 3) support to draft post-incident note (tara/luis) 4) SRE to create short RCA once logs correlated (jen). I'll remain on the thread for handoff in 30m to day shift. If anything regresses ping @amber_oncall immediately.

incident-bot: Incident 'ecl-772-obsv-gap' created, severity=P1, incident lead=amber_oncall, incident channel=#inc-ecl-772-obsv-gap

amber_oncall: thanks team. one quick ask — can we add a short line to the postmortem about tenant isolation risks and add the mitigation (bypass/proxy fallback) as a supported play? will save time next time.

jen_sre: noted. I'll capture the timeline and add logs from forwarder/secret-manager.

matt_infra: monitoring will show rotation failures as an alert now per INFRA-4721. tagging infra-runbook.

tara_support: publishing interim update to customer and setting 60m follow-up.

luis_custops: handoff to day ops in 28m. leaving channel but reachable. :thumbsup:

amber_oncall: handoff acknowledged. keeping this channel open for 30m then will escalate into full postmortem if root cause confirmed. good job everyone.
